title: When Is the Perfect Time to Switch Companies in India? Signs, Timing and a Checklist
seoTitle: When to Switch Companies in India: Signs, Timing, Checklist
seoDescription: When to switch jobs in India: signs it's time, timing around bonuses, gratuity and notice periods, how to judge a hike, and a job-switch checklist.
excerpt: There's no perfect month to switch companies, but there is a perfect situation. Learn the signs it's time to move, how to time your switch around bonuses, vesting, gratuity and notice periods, and what to do before and after you resign.
